framework: aavas.automl.portfolio random search (catboost 1.2.10, lightgbm 4.7.0, scikit-learn 1.6.1, xgboost 3.2.0)

rule.tie_break: families within 1.0% (relative) of the best score are tied; among them the most explainable class wins, then the better score

notes: The trainers' holdout (the last 20% by application date) was never passed to this search; validation is the later part of the training window.

Classifiers are ranked on AUC, which calibration cannot change. log_loss, brier and ece are for the raw learner: the trainer calibrates the selected model isotonically afterwards, so deployed calibration is better than recorded here.
